case.title: A refused lead change in Edit Work Order saves none of the other edits
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 2 tabs of the same browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • 2 technicians eligible at this location: active, Role Technician, at least one Department, Location Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, Time Clock on. Names are examples ("Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards").
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Refused" (used by this case only) with one contact and one asset.
  • One work order [WO-1] with one completed line, Lead Technician = [Tech-A], Mileage 120,000, Engine Hours 3,420, Customer PO "PO-100", status Complete (reviewed, not invoiced).
  • Two tabs of the same browser window, both signed in as Admin ShopView. Names and numbers are examples.

Setup

  1. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff: if no suitable technician exists, click New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = any one (at least one Department is required) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-A] (the expected results call this technician "Esther Howard").
  2. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff: if no suitable technician exists, click New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = any one (at least one Department is required) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-B] (the expected results call this technician "Ralph Edwards"). Use a second, different technician.
  3. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Refused" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-118" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Refused" > Asset = its asset > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-714").
  5. In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Close.
  6. On [WO-1], on the status card at the left, click Lead Technician and pick [Tech-A]. (Lead Technician is a dropdown only once the work order is Approved; while it is an Estimate it reads "Unassigned" and cannot be changed.) The choice saves at once.
  7. On the status card type Mileage 120000 and Engine Hours 3420 (each saves when you leave the field). On the Finance tab type "PO-100" in Customer PO.
  8. Bring it to Complete: on the Lines tab click Complete on the line > Tech Story: type any text > if a "Missing Details (1)" step shows, click it and type a Mileage > Complete Line (or Complete All Lines). The message "Work order sent to review." appears and the status reads Review. Click Mark Reviewed; if a Mark as reviewed window asks for VIN, type any 17 characters (e.g. 1FVACWDT1BDAZ0001) > Confirm Review. The status reads Complete.
  9. Check the setup worked: reload [WO-1]. Status Complete, Lead Technician [Tech-A], Mileage 120,000, Engine Hours 3,420, Customer PO "PO-100".
case.custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] (Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST Edit WO Refused" > click the work order). Its status reads Complete.
  2. Click the Finance tab and click Create Invoice so the work order is Invoiced. Close the New Customer Payment window (X) without paying.
  3. Reload the page. The status reads Invoiced.
  4. There is no separate Edit Work Order window; the edits are tried on the status card (the card at the left of the work order page that shows the status, Lead Technician, Mileage and Engine Hours).
  5. On the status card try to change Lead Technician to [Tech-B].
  6. Try to change Mileage to 120500.
  7. Try to change Engine Hours to 3470.
  8. Reload the page and read Lead Technician, Mileage and Engine Hours on the status card.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 5 to 7: none of the three can be changed on an Invoiced work order. Lead Technician offers no list of technicians to pick from, and Mileage and Engine Hours cannot be edited (or, if a change is tried, it is refused with a message and not saved).
  • Step 8: Lead Technician still reads "Esther Howard", Mileage 120,000 and Engine Hours 3,420. None of the edits was saved.
  • Note: the Customer PO on the Finance tab has its own separate save and is not part of this check (QA lead's ruling below).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, High 1; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §7; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (§4 Key Decisions). Source-verified 8 October 2026.
  • QA lead's ruling, 9 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat, given with screenshots after we reported that no Edit Work Order window opens for an existing work order. Part A, word for word: “For Lead technician. There are two places as appearing in the screenshots. The work order can not be edited directly, you edit their lines by navigating to the work order first and then by clicking each line on the work order. Yes the rest can be done from the cards appearing at the left on each work order. And Yes, ideally those checks use that card instead.”
  • QA lead's ruling, 12 Oct 2026, in the QA session chat. Question put to him: “Blocked test 9: there's no single edit window, so the lead, mileage and engine hours simply can't be changed on an invoiced work order and stay put; the PO is saved on its own from the Finance tab. What should it say?” His answer, word for word: “Passed (Recommended)”. The steps were moved to the status card and the PO left out on 12 Oct 2026 under Rule 114(d).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply High 1: “If the lead change is refused, the other edits in the same save (mileage, engine hours, PO) are not saved either.”
  • QA handoff §7: “Edit Work Order on a Paid work order, with a different lead and a changed mileage, is refused”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (lead lock): “Lead technician cannot be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid. This is a product rule, not only a screen rule, so it must hold on every path that changes the lead technician — board drag, Reassign dialog, and the work order detail page.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
